_note: Four phases. Each only ADDS systems. era(s) returns one of these; Titles (4) is planned and never triggers yet.

list.name: Beginning
list.desc: First character, adventuring, a house, kids.

list.name: Established
list.desc: A nice house, a working family and minions, a small estate economy.
list.hint: build a home on your land and start a family (or reach 300 Renown)

list.name: Dynasty
list.desc: Larger holdings, rival families, feuds and wars.
list.hint: a Manor-level estate (estate level 60) and 3+ living adults

list.name: Titles
list.desc: Barony, land, towns, lords, roads, court and taxes.
list.hint: Titles (barony, lords, court, taxes) are planned
